title.title: The title of the API
title.description: While a title is not required, implementors are strongly advised to include one.

description.title: The description of the API
description.description: A longer description of the API.
description.example: Access to data about buildings in the city of Bonn via a Web API that conforms to the OGC API Common specification.

attribution.title: Attribution for the API
attribution.description: The `attribution` for the API should be short and intended for presentation to a user, for example, in a corner of a map. Parts of the text can be links to other resources if additional information is needed. The string can include HTML markup or markdown.

attributionMediaType.title: Media type of the attribution
attributionMediaType.description: Media type for the markup language of the attribution: It can be either plain text (`text/plain`), HTML (`text/html`) or https://commonmark.org/[CommonMark] (`text/markdown`).

links.title: Links to resource in the API
links.description: Links to this or other resources provided by the API.

href.title: URI of the resource
href.description: URI to a remote resource (or resource fragment).

rel.title: Link relation
rel.description: The type or semantics of the relation.

type.title: Media type of the response
type.description: A hint indicating what the media type of the result of dereferencing the link should be.

hreflang.title: Language of the response
hreflang.description: A hint indicating what the language of the result of dereferencing the link should be.

title.title: Short summary of the resource
title.description: Used to label the destination of a link such that it can be used as a human-readable description.

length.title: Length of the response
length.description: A hint indicating the Content-length of the result of dereferencing the link should be.
